## Schemas in PIFDataModel

The following schemas are available in the PIFDataModel package.


| **Category**      | **Name**                        | **Description**                                       | **Link**                                               |
|--------------------|--------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Bacteria**       | Count                          | Schema for bacteria count information                 | [View](./schemas/bacteria_count_schema.json)               |
|                    | General                        | Schema for general information about bacteria         | [View](./schemas/bacteria_schema.json)                     |
|                    | Prevalence                     | Schema for bacteria prevalence                        | [View](./schemas/bacteria_prevalence_schema.json)          |
|                    | Results                        | Schema for results related to bacteria analysis       | [View](./schemas/bacteria_general_results_schema.json)             |
|                    | Tree                           | Schema for hierarchical tree structure of bacteria    | [View](./schemas/bacteria_tree_schema.json)                |
